## Tailoring Summary

PM-10 is `Required` at `Formal` rigor. The project has a material product-direction change from self-hosted WordPress to a proposed self-hosted web application, a fixed program deadline, restricted participant content, unresolved infrastructure decisions, and multiple acceptance authorities. A short but auditable scope-control approach is proportionate; a full enterprise scope manual is not.

## Authority Boundary

This run may draft the scope-management approach and proposed control records. It may not approve the new product scope, establish a baseline, supersede existing decisions, close WordPress work, or update canonical records without explicit post-review PM approval.
